verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS data-activation platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Hightouch's source is available or openly licensed. The only license mention concerns Rudderstack, a different product, and the published OpenAPI spec and SDKs do not amount to open-licensed product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
